about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I combine a keen eye for aesthetics with the technical expertise as a former Amazon Engineer. Having built and optimized large-scale applications at Amazon, I understand exactly what it takes to create a user experience that is both intuitive and robust.

Great design shouldn't just look good — it needs to work seamlessly for your users. That's where I come in. If you have a business ready to refresh your online presence, I'm here to bring your vision to life!
